summary: Found live by the user on the 1.3.0 portable extract during MPI-391 A2: models folder pointed at the G: CubricModels store which holds real weights, home hero still reads MODELS 0 / 18. Root traced to a gating chain rather than a render fault - syncModelInstalled is subscribed to engine:ready (js/shell.js:1465, comment says it waits for extra_model_paths.yaml), and getCustomRoot reads that yaml from inside ENGINE_ROOT (routes/shared.js:423), written only by a local engine provision (routes/engine.js:519). With MPI-390's skip-install on there is no engine, so the event never fires and the resolver has no root; 0 is the untouched initial from heroStats.js:47. Real question is whether the first-run models-root choice should outlive the engine as an app-level setting.

DIAGNOSIS CONFIRMED live in the same app session, no code changed. On RunPod connect the hero went 0 / 18 to 4 / 18 - the connect edge re-runs syncModelInstalled (js/shell.js:1501) and that run had a models root to stat, namely the Pod volume. So the check itself is healthy and correctly plumbed; it was only ever starved of a root in the skip-install case. That rules out any fault in the counter, in heroStats or in the check payload, and narrows the fix squarely onto where the models root comes from when no engine exists. Diagnostic value: a cloud-only user sees a truthful count the moment they connect and a false zero before that, so the bug is scoped to the pre-connect window rather than to remote mode.

maturity idea -> planned. root cause is on the card - the model check is gated on an engine that will never exist on this path. Board-wide re-stamp against the grown 10-value enum (todo gained research / needs-decision / blocked / deferred on 2026-07-31); every todo card had been sitting on idea or planned because those were the only values that existed when it was written.

PRODUCT DECISION ANSWERED by the user: the models root stays ENGINE-OWNED. The hero must simply not claim a count it cannot have - zero-of-eighteen is the untouched initial value, not a measurement. No app-level models-root setting, no change to getCustomRoot, to who writes extra_model_paths.yaml, or to the engine:ready gate on syncModelInstalled. Written up in brief.md (which the card already linked but did not have on disk), and the two acceptance lines that assumed the other branch were reworded. The card is unblocked for implementation; the absorbed MPI-405 half is unaffected.

note: Implementing the decided fix. Hero must not claim a count it cannot have (models root stays engine-owned), plus the absorbed MPI-405 half (Stage-all-models toggle live with no RunPod API key).

Implemented. heroStats.js renders the models slot as an unknown dash when hasNoEngine() is true, repainting on engine:ready and the remote connect edge; MpiRunpodSettings _applyEnabled now hides the Stage-all-models plate with the other key-gated controls. No server change. Evidence + the one remaining live check in validation.md.
